reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 1 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Nuggets (revenge).
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 50 times in 100; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
